strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and reverses. Enter at the price level of the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs, enter at the top of the grab candle after sell-side liquidity is taken; for shorts, enter at the bottom of the grab candle after bu
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity-grab wick (below it for longs, above it for shorts). Take profit at the nearest recent swing level in the reversal direction: a recent high for longs or a recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on multiple timeframes; examples shown on general charts
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Use the liquidity-grab candle as the entry reference
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent swing high/low
variants.transcript_quote: your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab

variants.timeframe_note: Example uses 15-minute entry chart with 1-hour higher-timeframe check
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Only take the base setup when the lower-timeframe signal occurs at a higher-timeframe support or resistance extreme
variants.target_note: Normal stop loss and take profit as in the base setup
variants.transcript_quote: we move back to the 15-minute time frame and do our normal stop loss and take profit

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Combine the base liquidity-grab setup with momentum divergence for added probability
variants.target_note: Uses the same base trade management
